definition.def: Contact involves meeting or communicating with someone, especially regularly.
examples: Opposition leaders are denying any contact with the rebels. [+ with]
He forbade contact between directors and executives outside his presence. [+ between]

definition.def: If you are in contact with someone, you regularly meet them or communicate with them. If you get in contact with someone, you start to communicate with them.
examples: He was in direct contact with the kidnappers. [+ with]
We do keep in contact.
Perhaps you can help us to get in contact with her. [+ with]

definition.def: If you contact someone, you phone them, write to them, or go to see them in order to tell or ask them something.
examples: Contact the Tourist Information Bureau for further details. [VERB noun]
When she first contacted me, Frances was upset. [VERB noun]

definition.def: Your contact details or number are information such as a phone number where you can be contacted.
examples: You must leave your full name and contact details when you phone.

definition.def: If you come into contact with someone or something, you meet that person or thing in the course of your work or other activities.
examples: Doctors I came into contact with voiced their concern.
The college has brought me into contact with western ideas.

definition.def: If you make contact with someone, you find out where they are and talk or write to them.
examples: Then, after she had become famous, he tried to make contact with her.

definition.def: If you lose contact with someone who you have been friendly with, you no longer see them, speak to them, or write to them.
examples: Though they all live nearby, I lost contact with them really quickly.
Mother and son lost contact when Nicholas was in his early twenties.

definition.def: When people or things are in contact, they are touching each other.
examples: They compared how these organisms behaved when left in contact with different materials.
The cry occurs when air is brought into contact with the baby's larynx.
There was no physical contact, nor did I want any.
This shows where the foot and shoe are in contact.

definition.def: Radio contact is communication by means of radio.
examples: He failed to make radio contact.
The plane lost contact with the control tower shortly after take-off. [+ with]

definition.def: A contact is someone you know in an organization or profession who helps you or gives you information.
examples: Their contact in the United States Embassy was called Phil.

definition.def: If you make eye contact with someone, you look at them at the same time as they look at you, so that you are both aware that you are looking at each other. If you avoid eye contact with someone, you deliberately do not look straight at them because you feel awkward or embarrassed.
examples: She was looking at me across the room, and we made eye contact several times.
I walked down the high street, avoiding eye contact with passers-by.
